name: Smart Ai Forms Lite
author: cpimediabhushan

sections.description:
Smart Ai Forms Lite is a streamlined form builder designed for bloggers,
small businesses and anyone who needs to collect information from visitors.
This free version focuses on the essentials: text fields, email and phone
inputs, dropdowns, radio buttons, checkboxes, HTML blocks and dividers.
Create unlimited forms and gather responses right from your WordPress admin.

Key features

  • Drag-and-drop form builder with real-time preview.
  • Unlimited forms and unlimited fields.
  • Basic field customisation including labels, placeholders and required settings.
  • Email notifications for new submissions.
  • Export entries to CSV.
  • 100% responsive design that looks great on mobile devices.

Advanced features like conditional logic, multi-page forms, payment integrations,
calculations and analytics are not included in this lite version. To access
those capabilities, please visit https://www.smartaiforms.com/ to learn about
the Pro edition.

Credits

Smart Ai Forms Lite is developed and maintained by Bhushan Mehta. It is released
under the GPL v2 or later. No external licensing SDK or trialware is included in
this version.

External services

This plugin links to the Smart Ai Forms website to provide documentation and upgrade information.

  • Service: Smart Ai Forms website (https://www.smartaiforms.com/).
  • What is sent: No data is sent automatically. If you click on an upgrade or documentation link,
    your browser will connect to the site and send standard HTTP request information (such as IP address
    and user agent).
  • When: Only when you follow a link from the plugin interface.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.smartaiforms.com/ (see that site’s footer for the ToS link).
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.smartaiforms.com/ (see that site’s footer for the privacy policy link).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-ai-forms-lite folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Smart Ai Form Lite > Add New Form in the dashboard.
  4. Build your form using the drag-and-drop builder, save it and copy the shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode into any post, page or widget where you want the form to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I embed a form on my site?

After creating your form, copy the shortcode from the top of the form
builder screen (it looks like [smaraifo_form id="123"]). Paste
that shortcode into the content editor of a post, page or widget.

Can I use conditional logic, calculations or payment fields?

Not in the lite version. Those advanced features are available in the
Pro edition, which is a separate plugin available for purchase.

Will my forms still work if I upgrade?

Yes. You can install the Pro version alongside this plugin. The Pro plugin
will automatically detect existing forms created with the lite version and
enhance them. We recommend deactivating the lite plugin after activating the
Pro edition to avoid duplicate menu items.
